decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records both connector clearance from mounting holes and minimum spacing between the connectors, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Connector clearance around mounting holes does not change the battery's electrical protection behavior or thresholds.
The mechanical connector-clearance decision does not change the requirement for NTC thermal monitoring through J_BAT.
The power-board mounting-hole clearance decision does not alter the main-board SK6812 charge-status interface.
The source decision concerns physical connector placement on the power board and does not change the addressable-LED family, power, or data interface.
Mounting-hole and connector spacing constraints do not change the 5V boost converter's enable control, default state, or powered loads.
The mechanical clearance decision does not alter I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up board location.
